verdict.rationale: RUN offers its own background automation for one workflow: RUN & DONE puts recurring payroll on autopilot, and pay deposits and tax filings happen automatically on schedule. That is a real recurring, autonomous capability, not a one-off action, but it is limited to payroll rather than user-configurable automations, and API Central is only a developer building block. Missing for 10: general user-defined automation or workflow builder, configurable triggers and schedules beyond payroll, details on how RUN & DONE is set up and runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
